deadline.value: The PhD deadline for fall is December 15; applications open around August 15; no spring PhD intake (year inferred).
deadline.quote: The PhD deadline for fall is December 15th.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required for PhD applicants.
gre_general.quote: Please note: The GRE is not required for PhD applicants.

english_waiver.value: A waiver is granted only to citizens of countries, or holders of degrees from countries or institutions, where English is the official language or language of higher education; confirm eligibility for Indian degrees with Graduate Admissions.
english_waiver.quote: Graduate Affairs and Graduate Admissions will grant waivers only to students with citizenship from countries where the official language or language of instruction in higher education is English, or if a student has received or is about to receive a bachelors or master’s degree from an institution in the US or a country where English is the official language.

supervisor.value: Students are admitted by the department and assigned an initial academic advisor, who may not become the thesis advisor.
supervisor.quote: You will be assigned an initial academic advisor who may or may not become your eventual thesis advisor.

funding.value: All full-time CS PhD students in good standing are guaranteed full funding (about USD 50,000 stipend, tuition, health insurance).
funding.quote: All full-time CS PhD students in good academic standing are guaranteed full funding.

entry_route.value: Entering students are expected to have a program equivalent to the BS in computer science; no master's is required.
entry_route.quote: Entering students are expected to have completed a program of study equivalent to that required by the BS in computer science.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: No separate data science PhD; machine learning, AI and data science are research areas.
